title: The Inquisition and the Kindred
summary: How the Inquisition broke the open rule of the clans.

claims.text: By the Middle Ages vampires preyed openly on mortals, until an organized Inquisition rose to destroy them.
Hundreds of vampires died, and the survivors saved themselves by steering the Inquisition onto the poor and powerless, at the cost of hundreds of thousands of mortal lives.
The Kindred survived but were never the same afterward.

title: Vlad Tepes, Dracula
summary: Prince of Wallachia turned vampire, counted among the Inconnu.

claims.text: Dracula is described as a member of the Inconnu.
Tales of the mad prince of Wallachia and the stakes spread across Europe and the Near East, and Kindred rumour set them beside talk of a mystic of the Inconnu.
When Dracula warned that the Antediluvians threatened the Kindred, the clans struck back through human and vampire proxies, and Camarilla, Sabbat and Inquisition foes all hunted Dracula.

title: Tyler
summary: A Brujah elder and revolutionary of the Camarilla.

claims.text: Tyler is a Brujah elder of the Camarilla who fights against every system of enforced injustice.

title: Karsh
summary: The Gangrel warlord of the Camarilla.

claims.text: Karsh stands among the enforcers of the Camarilla against anarchs, Sabbat paladins, Lupines and hunters.
Abandoned by a lord in mortal life, Karsh came to serve only the Gangrel and the Camarilla.

title: Vasantasena
summary: A Malkavian antitribu of the Sabbat whose madness burns bright.

claims.text: Vasantasena is a Malkavian antitribu whose madness shows as too bright a light rather than darkness.
Even fierce Sabbat leaders find this divinely inspired lunatic unsettling.

title: Rafael de Corazon
summary: The Toreador elder who urged the Kindred to hide from mortals.

claims.text: With the Inquisition and the anarchs closing in, Rafael de Corazon called on the elders to give up their open ties to mortals and pass into shadow.
Rafael came from the Spain of the wars between Christians and Muslims, and mediocre art brought little standing among the Toreador.

title: Gratiano
summary: A Lasombra elder of the Sabbat born to the de Veronese family.

claims.text: Gratiano was born to the wealthy de Veronese family of Italy and excelled in war, trade and politics.
Gratiano entered the priesthood young and sought a bishopric.

title: Lambach
summary: A Tzimisce elder of the Sabbat in Transylvania.

claims.text: Lambach is a Tzimisce elder of the Sabbat in the strife-torn lands of Transylvania and Romania.
Lambach knew well the Tzimisce power to mould mortal flesh.

title: Montano
summary: A Lasombra antitribu of the Camarilla, haunted by the death of the clan founder.

claims.text: Montano was born thousands of years ago on the Maasai steppes of East Africa.
The destruction of the Lasombra Antediluvian torments Montano more than any other Kindred.
Other Lasombra never felt fully at ease around Montano.

title: Etrius
summary: A member of the Tremere Inner Circle.

claims.text: Etrius sits on the Inner Circle of Clan Tremere.
The Tremere are the one clan whose founder became a vampire by personal effort rather than another's bite; it began as a medieval house of wizards losing its hold as magic faded.

title: Durga Syn
summary: An independent Ravnos elder tied to Baba Yaga.

claims.text: Durga Syn is an independent Ravnos elder of Russia.
Russian peasants feared the Nosferatu Baba Yaga above all, and Baba Yaga's influence lingered long after torpor.
Baba Yaga appeared at Durga Syn's deathbed.

title: Genevra
summary: A Giovanni necromancer allied with the Sabbat.

claims.text: The Giovanni kept great power in Italy through the Inquisition by working closely with the Church, some say too closely.
Genevra is a Giovanni allied with the Sabbat.

title: Jalan-Aajav
summary: A Black Hand seraph of the Sabbat.

claims.text: Jalan-Aajav is a seraph of the Black Hand, and the name alone terrifies the undead of the Sabbat underground.
The Sabbat invokes Jalan-Aajav to destroy an enemy or frighten a reluctant ally.

title: Dominique
summary: A Ventrue antitribu of the Sabbat.

claims.text: Dominique is a Ventrue antitribu of the Sabbat.
The Sabbat prizes freedom from authority, from the elders and from the Antediluvians above all.
